svg.title: A quality adapter for egocentric hand detection
svg.desc: Two film strips of video frames: the raw detector misses hands in some frames and fires false positives in others; after the adapter, false positives are rejected and missed frames are interpolated. Below, detections stream through the six stages: false positives are rejected at the geometric filter and temporal rejection stages, and missed detections are filled at gap interpolation.

g.text: A quality adapter for egocentric hand detection
Detector-agnostic post-processing that fixes false positives and false negatives without retraining.
No ground truth. Every threshold is calibrated from the data's own distributions. The stereo-depth stage didn't generalize, so it ships opt-in.
